why: A part written on an `<ng-template>` inside the arrow's icon, under a structural directive. Angular renders none of an `<ng-template>`'s attributes — they are read for directive matching alone — so the part names nothing a stylesheet can reach, and the place for it is the `<pct-icon>`. The walk reads the `<ng-template>` as the tag it is written as, and walks the template the directive wraps around it through to it: that wrapper carries no tag (`tagName` is null) and no attribute.
